    Theorem A (= Theorem 4.5) #

    Let D_i = k^(T_i) be the linearization of the Aronszajn system of Construction 4.3, indexed by the countable ordinals. Its transition maps are surjective and lim D = 0 while D_0 = k (Lemma 4.1), so C(D) has no triangulated embedding by Theorem B. Countable families of objects lie in some C_{[0, m]}, which has an algebraic realization by Corollary 2.4, since countable sets of countable ordinals are bounded. The remaining properties come from Proposition 4.4 and from dim D_i = |T_i| ≤ ℵ₀.
